explication: Rojo maps filesystem projects into Roblox instance trees, then supports CLI builds/deployment, live Studio synchronization, and importing Studio changes back to files. The main live path is project/filesystem input → snapshot middleware → snapshot diff/application → served tree and client updates. CLI commands, web/API handling, and syncback are distinct product branches. Relationships reflect the excerpts, source index, or README; unsampled command and integration internals are not inferred.
